subject: Redwood + Acuvera: evaluation sprint synthesis & test asks
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Evan Clarke <evan.clarke@acuvera.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@acuvera.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-18 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood + Acuvera: evaluation sprint synthesis & test asks

Thanks again for taking the call earlier, Evan and Priya — appreciated the time and clarity on the outcome you need. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so we’re aligned before the sprint kicks off.

Key pains you highlighted
- Predictable per-request latency under bursty daytime traffic (mortgage appraisal pipeline)
- Cost spikes on longer contexts; need guidance on unit economics for 8k+ token workflows
- Strict auditability and retention controls for regulatory review

Goals for the 3-week evaluation sprint
1) Validate steady-state 95th percentile latency at target payloads (10–25 req/s)
2) Measure token cost delta across quantization and batching profiles on representative prompts
3) Prove retention and audit log export to your S3 + KMS setup

Open questions / assumptions we made in the call
- You’ll provide a replay of the typical prompt distribution and the top 10 templates (we agreed Priya will share).
- Acuvera wants a side-by-side comparison versus your incumbent: two baseline models + Redwood optimized variants.
- Decision criteria: latency, cost/per-req, infra integration effort, and output consistency (QA pass rate).

Proposed immediate next steps
- Priya: drop the prompt set and a short sample of traffic by EOD Tuesday (attachment: redwood-test-plan.md referenced).
- Rafael + Lauren (cc’d): we’ll ship a simplified evaluation checklist and a side-by-side matrix by Wednesday.
- Schedule: kickoff run and results sync in 10 business days; I’ll propose a slot once we have artifacts.

Attachments: redwood-test-plan.md (test cases + measurement hooks)

Thanks — Tessa

Tessa Morgan
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
T: +1 (415) 555-0187
From: Evan Clarke <evan.clarke@acuvera.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acuvera.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-18 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood + Acuvera: evaluation sprint synthesis & test asks

Tessa — thanks for the crisp recap. A couple quick clarifications from our side: 

1) Prompt set: Priya will share the templates + a 48-hour sample of anonymized requests. We’ll strip PII but keep length distribution intact.
2) Comparison baseline: incumbent is a managed endpoint from VectorCloud; we want you to run the same scenarios against VectorCloud + Redwood hosted variant.
3) Security: we need to confirm whether Redwood’s audit logs include request payload hashes and key rotation metadata; put that in the checklist if possible.

Also — two asks that matter for procurement:
- Can you provide a ballpark cost projection for 100m tokens/month (mix of short + long contexts) with the optimized profiles?
- Is there a documented SLA for sustained throughput (we expect bursts up to 30 req/s for 10–15s windows)?

We’re generally aligned on the timeline. I’ll upload the artifacts tonight. Thanks — Evan

Evan Clarke
Director, ML Platform | Acuvera Systems
E: evan.clarke@acuvera.com
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Evan Clarke <evan.clarke@acuvera.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-19 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood + Acuvera: evaluation sprint synthesis & test asks

Appended a short side-by-side matrix and checklist (see attachments). Highlights from our internal prep: 

- Measurement plan: we’ll run three load profiles (steady 10 req/s, ramp 25 req/s sustained 60s, burst 30 req/s x 20s) and capture 50k token-samples for cost analysis.
- Model variants: Redwood-v1 (baseline), Redwood-v1-quant (8-bit), Redwood-v1-fp16 (higher perf), plus VectorCloud baseline.
- Auditability: logs include request metadata, payload hashes (SHA256), KMS key IDs for encryption-at-rest, and configurable retention windows.

Attachments included: acuvera-eval-checklist.xlsx; side_by_side-matrix.csv

Quick answers to Evan’s procurement asks:
- Ballpark: for 100M tokens/month mixed profile estimate ~ $8.7k–$12.5k depending on batching and quantization; we’ll provide a more precise per-profile table after the first run.
- SLA: we offer a Dedicated tier SLA that guarantees median latency bands and throughput commitments; I’ve linked the SLA doc in the Drive folder.

Next steps from us: Rafael and Lauren will run the initial baseline tests on Wednesday and share raw logs + a summary CSV.

— Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
From: Evan Clarke <evan.clarke@acuvera.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acuvera.com>, Gloria Mendes (EvalOps)
Date: 2027-04-19 11:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood + Acuvera: evaluation sprint synthesis & test asks

Rafael — this is great and addresses most of our questions. Two quick clarifications before you start tests:

- Can you include the raw per-request latency histogram in the outputs (not just p50/p95/p99)? We’ll want to run our own tail analysis.
- For the VectorCloud run, please ensure identical container configs (sequence length caps, top-k/top-p) so we can compare apples-to-apples.

I’ll ask Gloria to monitor the runs from our side and upload any anomalies. Priya will send over the templates now. Thanks for the SLA pointer — procurement will review.

Best, Evan
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Evan Clarke <evan.clarke@acuvera.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@acuvera.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-20 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood + Acuvera: evaluation sprint synthesis & test asks

Thanks — noted. Rafael and Lauren will add full histograms and ensure the VectorCloud run mirrors configs.

Tentative schedule: baseline runs start tomorrow (4/21), interim sync 4/28, final readout 5/6. I’ll upload the combined results folder and a short playbook with how we computed cost numbers.

Attachments: redwood-test-plan.md (updated with run-times)

See you on the sync — Tessa
